notes: Results page is votetravis.gov 'Election Results and Reconciliation Forms' (title/URL in search results). Platform county_pdfs: search result URLs show results PDFs on the county domain under votetravis.gov/wp-content/uploads/travis-tx/election-results/ (e.g. 'Precinct Summary Results Report Joint General and Special Election' G20 Final Precinct.pdf for Nov 2020; Democratic Cumulative.pdf for May 2022 runoff titled OFFICIAL RESULTS). These are older elections and the filenames do not timestamp election-night precinct posting. LEADS only (search summaries): Nov 5 2024 as of 9:42 p.m. the clerk had not yet posted Election Day results; for Mar 2026 the clerk changed how it reports early voting results (counting began on election day) which delayed results; neither statement addresses when precinct-level detail appeared. Phone (512) 238-8683 appeared only in a search summary (email redacted), not attributed verbatim to a county page, so left empty. The 2026 early-vote reporting change is not a precinct-level reporting change, so stated_change_2026=n. No usage notice seen verbatim. Fetch module: 1 direct attempt on the results page plus wayback_probe (3 CDX windows), all robots_disallowed_or_unreachable. WebFetch: not attempted for Travis (all 3 WebFetch attempts in Dallas, including news hosts, returned EGRESS_BLOCKED).
tag_rationale: No source states when precinct-level results were posted on election night for any of the three target elections; existing precinct PDFs are from older elections and carry no posting time. Tag UNKNOWN.
